headline: Good morning — Wall Street slid almost 2% ahead of Nvidia's results, and a Bay of Bengal cyclone is heading for the Andhra Pradesh coast.

highlights.label: Wall Street slump
highlights.text: The S&P 500 fell about 1.9% and the Nasdaq about 2.5% on Monday as chip stocks sold off before Nvidia reports.

highlights.label: Andhra cyclone
highlights.text: A Bay of Bengal depression was forecast to strengthen into a severe cyclonic storm and approach the Andhra coast by 19 November.

highlights.label: India inflation
highlights.text: India's retail inflation reportedly rose to 6.1% in October, above the RBI's tolerance limit, while exports hit a record high.

tip.title: Prep a protein-and-veg snack
tip.body: Put a simple snack, such as fruit, nuts or yoghurt, where you can see it at your desk. Having a planned option makes it easier to skip a mid-afternoon vending-machine run. Notice how hungry you are before you eat.

quote.text: Quality is not an act, it is a habit.
quote.author: Aristotle (commonly attributed; paraphrased by Will Durant)

items.title: Attentive launches agentic AI marketing features
items.summary: Attentive unveiled agentic AI features at its Thread 2026 customer event. Older story (27 May 2026): no fresher MarTech coverage surfaced in searches.

items.title: Jasper releases suite of AI marketing agents
items.summary: Jasper launched AI agents aimed at automating core marketing functions. Undated listing page; recency not confirmed.

items.title: Klaviyo acquires social commerce platform Gatsby
items.summary: Klaviyo bought Gatsby for an undisclosed sum, extending its reach into social commerce. Undated listing page; recency not confirmed.

items.title: Microsoft Advertising moves to asset-level policy review
items.summary: Ad headlines, descriptions and images will now be checked individually for policy compliance. Advertisers may see single assets rejected rather than whole ads. Undated listing page.

items.title: Kroger consolidates retail media under Kroger Precision Marketing
items.summary: Kroger combined retail media, consumer insights and loyalty marketing under one brand. Undated listing page; recency not confirmed.

items.title: Agentforce Coworker usage up 21x in three months
items.summary: Salesforce says Coworker usage grew 21x in three months, with Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 connections added. Company-reported figures from 5 November.

items.title: Salesforce unveils AIforce at Dreamforce 2026
items.summary: AIforce is an interface layer exposing Salesforce data and permissions to external AI tools. Partnerships with Google Cloud, AWS and Siemens were also announced.

items.title: Biggest Dreamforce 26 announcements in a nutshell
items.summary: A roundup of the main Dreamforce 2026 product news. Several items, including Teams integration and the Hunter sales agent, are targeted for November availability but not confirmed as shipped.

items.title: Dreamforce 2026 signals a post-CRM-interface era
items.summary: Analysis argues Salesforce is repositioning around agents and external AI interfaces rather than its own CRM screens. Useful context for roadmap planning.

items.title: Salesforce rolls out job-specific AI agents for sales, service and HR
items.summary: Salesforce introduced role-specific AI agents across sales, service and HR. Older story (September 2026).

sfstatus.statusNote: Live status could not be checked; a third-party tracker showed no current incidents but its timestamp is unclear. Verify at status.salesforce.com.

items.title: Salesforce recovers from multi-hour global outage (September)
items.summary: A September outage caused delays, intermittent errors and inaccessible services for customers. Older than 48 hours and included for context only.

items.title: Ken Wyatt named WA's first Indigenous governor
items.summary: Former federal minister Ken Wyatt has been named Western Australia's first Indigenous governor. Reported via an ABC regional briefing headline.

items.title: Severe storms forecast for south-east Queensland
items.summary: Residents were warned of large hail, heavy rain and damaging winds from midday Monday. Sydney Airport also reportedly cancelled 104 flights due to weather.

items.title: Fallout from Friday's Microsoft outage continues
items.summary: The Southern Gold Coast Chamber of Commerce warned effects of Friday's Microsoft outage would last several more days. Local businesses remain affected.

items.title: Victorian election early voting days away
items.summary: ABC briefings note the Victorian election is near, with early voting about to open. Details not confirmed from the briefing excerpt.

items.title: $500,000 reward in Forster missing-person case
items.summary: NSW Police planned to announce a reward over the disappearance of Marlon Mcdonald, last seen in Forster more than 14 years ago. A regional story included for lack of fuller national coverage.

items.title: Retail inflation reportedly 6.1% in October
items.summary: Retail inflation reportedly passed the RBI's upper limit to reach 6.1% in October. It raises pressure on interest-rate policy. Secondary source.

items.title: Exports touch record high
items.summary: A Hindu headline says exports hit a record as diversification pays off. Secondary source; figures not stated.

items.title: India to get preferential US market access, says Goyal
items.summary: Commerce minister Piyush Goyal said India will receive preferential access to the US market. India and Egypt are also reportedly working on a trade pact.

items.title: CRPF pulls anti-Naxal battalion from Chhattisgarh for Manipur
items.summary: The CRPF withdrew a battalion from anti-Naxal duty in Chhattisgarh to deploy it in Manipur. Secondary source.

items.title: Bay of Bengal cyclone threatens Andhra coast
items.summary: A depression was forecast to become a severe cyclonic storm heading towards Andhra Pradesh. Winds could reach 145 km/h by 19 November.

items.title: Cyclonic storm Akvan forecast to hit Andhra coast
items.summary: A Bay of Bengal depression was expected to intensify, with winds up to 145 km/h on the coast by 19 November. Coastal districts should watch official warnings.

items.title: Earlier storm damage hits Konaseema crops
items.summary: Reports cite over 73,500 coconut trees lost and paddy damage on 1.18 lakh acres in Konaseema, with at least 20 deaths. Figures are from a secondary summary.

items.title: Amaravati formally recognised as state capital
items.summary: Amaravati became the capital after the President assented to the AP Reorganisation Amendment Act. Older story; date not confirmed in search results.

items.title: Cabinet clears Rs 904 crore for Amaravati infrastructure
items.summary: The cabinet approved Rs 904 crore for infrastructure and 1,200 acres for a solar project. Date not confirmed; may be older.

items.title: Naidu sets out Amaravati as economic powerhouse
items.summary: The chief minister outlined plans for Amaravati as an economic and deep-tech hub and cleared capital projects. Date not confirmed; may be older.

items.title: Chip stocks drag market lower before Nvidia results
items.summary: Tech led Monday's selloff as traders positioned ahead of Nvidia's earnings. It was the S&P 500's third straight loss.

items.title: How major US indexes fared Monday
items.summary: Index closes for 16 November. Sources vary slightly on exact figures, so treat the Dow level as approximate.

items.title: Weak breadth: 355 S&P 500 stocks fell
items.summary: Only consumer staples and utilities finished higher. Nvidia reports Tuesday night US time, the next big catalyst.

items.title: Capital city clearance rate 48.9% in mid-August
items.summary: The final weighted clearance rate fell to 48.9% from 67.1% a year earlier, with Sydney at 47.1%. Older data (August); no newer release surfaced.

items.title: Home values fall 0.7% in July
items.summary: Cotality's index recorded its steepest monthly drop since December 2022, with weak auctions pointing to more downward pressure. Older data.

items.title: Spring sale shortage in a soft market
items.summary: Buyers face fewer listings this spring amid the market slump. Older story (August).

items.title: Auction volumes jump but clearance rates slip below 50%
items.summary: More homes went to auction while success rates stayed weak. Constrained borrowing capacity and affordability are limiting demand.

items.title: Clearance rate falls back below 50% after 12-week peak
items.summary: The clearance rate dropped below 50% after a brief rebound, well under the decade average of about 68%. Older story.
